answer: A fresh identity gets no echo of prior trust, so forgery yields no nectar of reward until real work accrues. Sybil resistance here comes from staking a scarce, non-transferable resource: each identity must lock a unique hardware attestation plus a decaying reputation bond earned by sustained contribution. The velvet ledger then slashes duplicate fingerprints, making each fake cost more than the genuine stake it mimics, so mass registration becomes economically irrational. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
